raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

GLM-5.3-Flash runs its KDA causal convolution on the default 8×256 Triton tile on gfx950 for its 6,144-channel (TP4) and 3,072-channel (TP8) width-4 prefill. Its mHC pre GEMM passes the FP32 `hc_fn` to AITER's `mhc_pre_gemm_sqrsum`, which then computes with FP32 MFMA and is bound by FP32 matrix throughput (68% MFMA utilization at 16K tokens).

This change selects a 32×512 causal-conv tile for the measured GLM-5.3-Flash geometry from the token counts where it beats the default, and packs each `hc_fn` once at weight load into AITER's BF16 hi/lo layout so the pre GEMM runs on BF16 MFMA through AITER's existing `w_preshuffle_bf16` path. No AITER change is required.

## Modifications

- Add a gfx950 GLM-5.3-Flash causal-conv prefill tile (`BLOCK_M=32`, `BLOCK_N=512`) for BF16 width-4 convolution at 6,144 channels from 12,288 tokens and at 3,072 channels from 24,576 tokens.
- Keep the default tile for every other channel count, width, dtype, token count, non-gfx950 device, and block-table launch.
- Pack `hc_attn_fn` and `hc_ffn_fn` once after weight load with AITER `mhc_shuffle_fn` on both the `load_weights` and `post_load_weights` paths; nothing is packed inside a forward, so CUDA-graph capture is unchanged.
- Pass the packed weight with `w_preshuffle_bf16=1` only while the cached entry belongs to the same parameter at the same version. An in-place weight update, any geometry other than the measured FP32 24 × 16,384 weight, or a missing AITER packing API keeps the FP32 GEMM.
- Add CPU dispatch contracts for the causal-conv thresholds and gfx950 tests for packed-weight parity, version invalidation, and the geometry gate.

## Accuracy Tests

Focused validation passed **2 CPU dispatch contracts, 9 gfx950 kernel tests with 38 subtests, and 270 Triton causal-conv layer tests**. Coverage includes the TP4/TP8 tile thresholds and their boundaries, default-tile fallbacks, packed-versus-FP32 mHC mixes and layer input at 1, 64, and 4,096 tokens, weight-version invalidation, the unmeasured-geometry gate, AITER import and runtime fallbacks, and CUDA-graph replay.

Full GLM-5.3-Flash TP8 GSM8K on snapshot `b5688f25491202978c19c4d036eef579f61bbe07`: 1,319 examples, 1,200 evaluator threads, 4,096 maximum output tokens, thinking enabled, temperature 1.0, top-p 0.95, sampling seed unset.

| Configuration | Score | Stop rate | Truncated rate | Error rate |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| GLM causal-conv tile + packed mHC pre GEMM | 97.12% | 99.55% | 0.45% | 0.00% |

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Environment:

- Hardware: AMD Instinct MI355X (`gfx950`)
- Docker image: `rocm/sgl-dev:v0.5.23-rocm724-mi35x-20261102`
- Model: `amd/GLM-5.3-Flash-Quark-MXFP4`, snapshot `b5688f25491202978c19c4d036eef579f61bbe07`
- Validated source SHAs: `3f2b0c5393` (A) and `647028d4c8` (B)

### Causal-convolution prefill latency

Single-sequence GLM-5.3-Flash geometry, BF16, width 4. GPU kernel time compares the default 8×256 tile against the 32×512 GLM tile; outputs are bitwise identical.

| TP | Channels | Tokens | Default tile (ms) | GLM tile (ms) | Delta |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 4 | 6,144 | 12,288 | 0.1442 | 0.1184 | **-17.86%** |
| 4 | 6,144 | 16,384 | 0.1912 | 0.1541 | **-19.44%** |
| 4 | 6,144 | 32,768 | 0.3789 | 0.2927 | **-22.75%** |
| 4 | 6,144 | 65,536 | 0.7425 | 0.5621 | **-24.29%** |
| 4 | 6,144 | 131,072 | 1.5481 | 1.0627 | **-31.35%** |
| 8 | 3,072 | 24,576 | 0.1385 | 0.1170 | **-15.53%** |
| 8 | 3,072 | 32,768 | 0.1882 | 0.1532 | **-18.63%** |
| 8 | 3,072 | 65,536 | 0.3639 | 0.2940 | **-19.21%** |
| 8 | 3,072 | 131,072 | 0.7124 | 0.5523 | **-22.47%** |

Three-sequence ragged batches at the same totals improve by 13.26-25.22%. Every enabled cell beat the default tile; shorter batches, where the GLM tile was slower, keep the default.

### mHC pre GEMM latency

AITER `mhc_pre_gemm_sqrsum` for GLM-5.3-Flash (`hc_mult=4`, hidden 4,096, 24 outputs). `hc_fn` is replicated across TP ranks, so TP4 and TP8 run the same shape. GPU kernel time compares the FP32 weight against the packed BF16 hi/lo weight:

| M | FP32 weight (ms) | Packed BF16 weight (ms) | Delta |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 1 | 0.0043 | 0.0035 | **-18.15%** |
| 64 | 0.0052 | 0.0045 | **-12.41%** |
| 512 | 0.0107 | 0.0082 | **-22.85%** |
| 2,048 | 0.0250 | 0.0154 | **-38.42%** |
| 4,096 | 0.0447 | 0.0249 | **-44.20%** |
| 8,192 | 0.0863 | 0.0534 | **-38.08%** |
| 16,384 | 0.1794 | 0.1256 | **-30.01%** |

Post and combine mixes match the FP32 GEMM to about 1e-6 relative; the BF16 layer input differs by at most one BF16 rounding step.

### End-to-end serving

GLM-5.3-Flash snapshot `b5688f25491202978c19c4d036eef579f61bbe07`, TP4, random 8K input / 1K output. Arms run the `RM/glm53` integration branch at `647028d4c8` (B) and the same source with exactly this PR's diff removed (A, `3f2b0c5393`).

A. `3f2b0c5393` — default causal-conv tile, FP32 mHC pre GEMM:

| Concurrency | TTFT (ms) | ITL (ms) | E2EL (ms) | Output tok/s |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 4 | 431.83 | 6.085 | 6821.93 | 600.14 |
| 8 | 683.77 | 6.800 | 8053.64 | 1016.47 |
| 16 | 1185.80 | 7.940 | 10218.53 | 1600.79 |
| 32 | 2181.70 | 9.435 | 13736.18 | 2384.22 |
| 64 | 4189.99 | 11.585 | 19980.16 | 3280.31 |

B. `647028d4c8` — GLM causal-conv tile + packed mHC pre GEMM (delta versus A):

| Concurrency | TTFT (ms) | Delta | ITL (ms) | Delta | E2EL (ms) | Delta | Output tok/s | Delta |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 4 | 425.52 | -1.46% | 6.060 | -0.41% | 6790.00 | -0.47% | 602.88 | +0.46% |
| 8 | 671.54 | -1.79% | 6.775 | -0.37% | 8008.18 | -0.56% | 1022.56 | +0.60% |
| 16 | 1163.82 | -1.85% | 7.915 | -0.31% | 10157.37 | -0.60% | 1610.70 | +0.62% |
| 32 | 2140.16 | -1.90% | 9.400 | -0.37% | 13620.99 | -0.84% | 2403.62 | +0.81% |
| 64 | 4106.39 | -2.00% | 11.570 | -0.13% | 19791.06 | -0.95% | 3310.75 | +0.93% |

The change improves TTFT by **1.46-2.00%**, ITL by 0.13-0.41%, E2E latency by 0.47-0.95%, and output throughput by 0.46-0.93% across the complete TP4 matrix.

### TP8 end-to-end serving

GLM-5.3-Flash TP8, 131,072 context, random 8K input / 1K output. Arms run `3f2b0c5393` (A) and `647028d4c8` (B) as above.

A. `3f2b0c5393` — default causal-conv tile, FP32 mHC pre GEMM:

| Concurrency | TTFT (ms) | ITL (ms) | E2EL (ms) | Output tok/s |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 4 | 373.86 | 5.500 | 6127.10 | 668.19 |
| 8 | 613.22 | 6.000 | 7115.78 | 1150.62 |
| 16 | 1084.78 | 6.560 | 8631.62 | 1896.36 |
| 32 | 2027.36 | 7.610 | 11573.83 | 2828.45 |
| 64 | 3917.33 | 8.955 | 16743.63 | 3912.72 |

B. `647028d4c8` — GLM causal-conv tile + packed mHC pre GEMM (delta versus A):

| Concurrency | TTFT (ms) | Delta | ITL (ms) | Delta | E2EL (ms) | Delta | Output tok/s | Delta |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 4 | 375.22 | +0.36% | 5.490 | -0.18% | 6112.20 | -0.24% | 669.78 | +0.24% |
| 8 | 611.65 | -0.26% | 5.980 | -0.33% | 7092.25 | -0.33% | 1154.70 | +0.36% |
| 16 | 1080.19 | -0.42% | 6.550 | -0.15% | 8609.69 | -0.25% | 1901.43 | +0.27% |
| 32 | 2014.51 | -0.63% | 7.565 | -0.59% | 11500.90 | -0.63% | 2844.31 | +0.56% |
| 64 | 3887.22 | -0.77% | 8.920 | -0.39% | 16651.57 | -0.55% | 3935.80 | +0.59% |

At TP8 the causal-conv tile starts at 24,576 tokens, so these 8K-16K prefill batches exercise only the packed mHC pre GEMM.

files.patch:
@@ -3,6 +3,7 @@
 import logging
 import math
 import threading
+import weakref
 from typing import Tuple
 
 import torch
@@ -33,6 +34,41 @@
 _AITER_MHC_RUNTIME_DISABLED = False
 _AITER_MHC_ACTIVE_LOGGED = False
 
+# id(hc_fn) -> (weakref to hc_fn, its _version when packed, AITER BF16 hi/lo layout).
+# Keyed by id because tensor __eq__ is elementwise. Packing happens at weight load,
+# never inside a forward, so captured graphs stay allocation-free.
+_AITER_PACKED_HC_FN = {}
+# Only the GLM-5.3-Flash geometry (hc_mult=4, hidden_size=4096) is measured.
+_AITER_PACKED_HC_FN_SHAPE = (24, 4 * 4096)
+
+
+def prepack_aiter_mhc_fn(fn: torch.Tensor) -> bool:
+    """Pack an FP32 hc_fn once for AITER's BF16 hi/lo mHC pre GEMM on gfx950."""
+    if (
+        not _use_aiter_mhc()
+        or fn.dtype != torch.float32
+        or tuple(fn.shape) != _AITER_PACKED_HC_FN_SHAPE
+    ):
+        return False
+    try:
+        from aiter.ops.mhc import mhc_shuffle_fn
+    except Exception as err:
+        logger.warning("AITER mHC weight packing is unavailable: %s", err)

+import unittest
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.mamba import causal_conv1d_triton
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=2, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class TestCausalConv1dDispatch(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_gfx950_glm_prefill_config(self):
+        with patch.object(
+            causal_conv1d_triton,
+            "is_gfx95_supported",
+            return_value=True,
+        ):
+            for dim, total_tokens in ((3072, 24576), (6144, 12288)):
+                with self.subTest(dim=dim, total_tokens=total_tokens):
+                    config = causal_conv1d_triton._causal_conv1d_prefill_config(
+                        dim=dim,
+                        width=4,
+                        total_tokens=total_tokens,
+                        dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+                    )
+                    self.assertEqual(config["BLOCK_M"], 32)
+                    self.assertEqual(config["BLOCK_N"], 512)
+                    self.assertEqual(config["num_warps"], 4)
+                    self.assertEqual(config["num_stages"], 3)
+
+    def test_other_geometries_keep_default(self):
+        base = dict(
+            dim=6144,
+            width=4,
+            total_tokens=12288,
+            dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        )
+        with patch.object(
+            causal_conv1d_triton,
+            "is_gfx95_supported",
+            return_value=True,
+        ):
+            for field, value in (
+                ("dim", 4096),
+                ("width", 3),
+                ("total_tokens", 12287),
+                ("dtype", torch.float16),
+            ):
+                with self.subTest(field=field, value=value):
+                    config = causal_conv1d_triton._causal_conv1d_prefill_config(
+                        **(base | {field: value})
+                    )
+                    self.assertEqual(config["BLOCK_M"], 8)
+                    self.assertEqual(config["num_stages"], 2)
+            with self.subTest(dim=3072, total_tokens=24575):
+                config = causal_conv1d_triton._causal_conv1d_prefill_config(
+                    **(base | {"dim": 3072, "total_tokens": 24575})
+                )
+                self.assertEqual(config["BLOCK_M"], 8)
+                self.assertEqual(config["num_stages"], 2)
+        with patch.object(
+            causal_conv1d_triton,
+            "is_gfx95_supported",
+            return_value=False,
+        ):
+            config = causal_conv1d_triton._causal_conv1d_prefill_config(**base)
+            self.assertEqual(config["BLOCK_M"], 8)
+            self.assertEqual(config["num_stages"], 2)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main(verbosity=3)
